title: Better Armour Progression
description: All iron and diamond armour are pretty easy to make, right? Well now they require leather armour to craft it! Iron helmet require a leather helmet. Diamond boots require a leather boots. etc.
body: This allows you to enjoy the lack of armour a little longer than usual. Iron and diamond armour require leather armour to craft, to make it a bit more realistic. Gold  and copper armour doesn't need it because they're weak.
